THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
119
STUDY 146
Navy Henley & Olive Cargo Trousers
Rights check
Source: 25047.jpg
Relaxed, utilitarian, casual
WORKING NOTES
- The olive cargo trousers and layered henley are the
defining pieces.
- Keep the keychain as a small, playful detail.
Try this: Keep the keychain as a playful detail.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, light
brown hair tucked behind one ear stands
against a white backdrop. She wears a
fitted navy ribbed henley with a short
button placket over a light gray layered
tank. Wide olive cargo trousers with
drawstring cuffs and side pockets sit
under a black belt, and a small silver
keychain dangles at one hip. White
chunky sneakers complete the look. Her
expression is calm. Soft, even studio
light. Palette of navy, heather gray, and
olive. Relaxed and utilitarian, in the style
of a streetwear catalog.
